category_title: High-functioning students with Asperger Disorder who are slow to start and easily disengaged
scenario_title: Transitioning to independent literacy task after a break
minimal_context: Ben is returning to his Year 3-4 composite classroom after a break to complete an independent handwriting task.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, break time is over. Please sit at your desks and begin your independent handwriting practice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Enters the classroom five minutes after the rest of the classmates and sits at his desk without starting the work.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ben, you need to start your handwriting task now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of his chair and begins sharpening his pencils instead of looking at the assignment.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your pencils are fine. Please sit down and do your work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits back at his desk but does not engage in the learning activity, choosing to play with a toy instead.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Class, break time is over. Please sit at your desks and begin your independent handwriting practice.

STUDENT: (Enters the classroom five minutes after the rest of the classmates and sits at his desk without starting the work.)

TUTOR: Ben, you need to start your handwriting task now.

STUDENT: (Gets out of his chair and begins sharpening his pencils instead of looking at the assignment.)

TUTOR: Your pencils are fine. Please sit down and do your work.

STUDENT: (Sits back at his desk but does not engage in the learning activity, choosing to play with a toy instead.)

task.content: A handwriting task or literacy task involving practising and reinforcing skills with which Ben was already familiar, rather than introducing completely new learning tasks

context.environment: Year 3-4 composite class, transitioning from school breaks back into the classroom
context.materials: Pencil and paper, objects, toys, pencils to sharpen
context.social_setting: Mainstream classroom where students are expected to begin independent work following whole-class instructions
context.time_context: The period immediately following whole-class instructions after a break

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Immediately following whole-class instructions when students are expected to begin independent work, despite receiving the same directions as his peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Was usually the last student to enter the room after breaks, up to five minutes after his classmates. Did not start work immediately, but played with objects, sharpened pencils, or sat at his desk not engaged in any specific learning activity.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Reluctant to engage with school work and was slow to start classroom activities, despite being capable of completing the work

behavior_patterns.condition: During general independent work periods where the student was expected to remain at his desk and engage with materials
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Being out of his chair, playing with toys, sharpening pencils
